SECTION 02 · TERMS & CONDITIONS
contract terms
CL. 01 — CL. 08
BINDING · GOVERNED BY THE LAWS OF [[GOVERNING_JURISDICTION_UC]]
clauses · 01—08
CL. 01
Equipment Supply

The Supplier supplies one (1) CaféMatic 5 commercial coffee machine and one (1) compatible milk cooler, as itemised in Schedule A, on a rental basis. The equipment remains the property of the Supplier (or its financing partner under Cl. 10) for the term.

CL. 02
Installation

The Supplier installs and commissions the equipment at the Customer's site on a pre-agreed date with all pre-installation requirements confirmed completed.

CL. 03
Service & Maintenance

The Supplier provides bi-annual preventative maintenance and calibration as part of this rental agreement, and bears the cost of all spare parts changes, save where the fault is caused by Customer negligence. The Customer shall purchase and apply daily cleaning materials at its own cost, using manufacturer-approved products; these are available from the Supplier at the rates in Schedule B. The Supplier shall respond to reported faults within twenty-four (24) hours of the request.

CL. 04
Consumables Supply

The Supplier supplies coffee beans, cocoa powder, and other consumables on demand, drawn from the menu in Schedule B. The Customer may add or remove items from the menu by written notice; pricing is per Schedule B.

CL. 05
Conservation Contribution

For each kilogram of conservation coffee purchased and paid for by the Customer, the Supplier contributes a percentage of the purchase value to the NGO conservation partner working in the landscape that coffee was sourced from. The applicable rate is set by the agreed coffee price in Schedule B: five percent (5%) where the agreed price is below [[CURRENCY]] [[RATE_RUNG_FULL]]/kg, and ten percent (10%) where the agreed price is at or above [[CURRENCY]] [[RATE_RUNG_FULL]]/kg. The rate applicable to the agreed price is stated in Schedule B and is fixed for the term unless the agreed price changes under Clause 06. Where the Customer elects a voluntary co-contribution (“Top-Up”), that amount is passed to the NGO partners in full, in addition to the percentage. Contributions are calculated on volume purchased and paid for, reconciled quarterly (31 March, 30 June, 30 September, 31 December), and paid to the NGO partners within sixty (60) days of each reconciliation date. Based on the agreed coffee price, the applicable conservation rate is , with a voluntary Top-Up of /kg.

CL. 06
Pricing

Equipment rental is fixed at the rate set in Schedule A for the term. Consumables are fixed at the rates in Schedule B for the first twelve (12) months from [[TERM_START]], then reviewed annually with thirty (30) days' written notice.

CL. 07
Order Process

Consumables orders are placed by email or messaging to the Supplier contact named in this agreement. Coffee is roasted to order on a weekly cycle: orders received by 12:00 on Monday ([[PREMISES_CITY]] time) are roasted that week and delivered on the Friday, or the following Monday. Orders received after that cut-off are roasted in the following week’s cycle. Other consumables are delivered with the next coffee delivery, or direct by the relevant supplier.

CL. 08
Payment

Equipment rental is invoiced monthly in advance by [[FINANCE_PARTNER]] (the financing partner under Cl. 10) and is payable on the due date stated in that invoice. Consumables are invoiced monthly in arrears by the Supplier on Net 30 day terms.

SECTION 02 · TERMS & CONDITIONS · CONT.
contract terms / 2.
CL. 09 — CL. 15
BINDING · GOVERNED BY THE LAWS OF [[GOVERNING_JURISDICTION_UC]]
clauses · 09—15
CL. 09
Term & Renewal

The term is [[TERM_MONTHS]] months, running from [[TERM_START]] to [[TERM_END]]. The Customer shall notify the Supplier in writing, no later than sixty (60) days before expiry, whether it wishes to renew the programme with the equipment then installed. Renewal is by mutual written agreement between the Customer and the Supplier. Any renewed term is contracted with, and all equipment rental under it invoiced by and paid to, the Supplier directly; the financing partner has no role in a renewed term. In the absence of agreement, the equipment is collected by the Supplier in accordance with Cl. 17.

CL. 10
Financing Partner

The equipment rental component is financed through [[FINANCE_PARTNER]]. During the initial term the Customer pays [[FINANCE_PARTNER]] directly for equipment rental and may need to onboard [[FINANCE_PARTNER]] as a payee in its accounts payable system. The Supplier remains the Customer's sole point of contact and is operationally and legally responsible for all matters relating to the equipment, service, coffee quality, and consumables.

CL. 11
Title & Risk

Title to the equipment remains with the Supplier or [[FINANCE_PARTNER]] throughout the term. The Supplier bears risk of loss or damage to the equipment in normal use. Damage from misuse or negligence is for the Customer's account at reasonable and documented cost.

CL. 12
Termination

Either party may terminate for material breach not cured within thirty (30) days of written notice. The Supplier may also terminate on non-payment exceeding sixty (60) days. Neither party may terminate for convenience during the term. On termination, the Customer permits collection of equipment within ten (10) business days subject to reasonable coordination with Customer and site access requirements. Collection is otherwise in accordance with Cl. 17.

CL. 13
Governing Law

This agreement is governed by the laws of [[GOVERNING_JURISDICTION]]. The [[GOVERNING_JURISDICTION]] courts have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising under it.

CL. 14
[[TAX_LABEL]]

All amounts payable under this agreement, including those set out in Schedule A and Schedule B, are exclusive of [[TAX_LABEL_LONG]]. [[TAX_LABEL]] will be added to invoices at the prevailing rate.

CL. 15
Confidentiality & Data Protection

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information disclosed by the other party and shall use it solely for the purposes of this agreement. This does not restrict disclosure to the financing partner under Cl. 10, or any disclosure that partner is required or permitted to make under the Lease. The Supplier may identify the Customer as a client and use its name and logo in marketing material with the Customer's prior written approval, not to be unreasonably withheld. Each party shall comply with [[DATA_PROTECTION_LAW]] and all other applicable data protection laws.

contract terms / 3.
CL. 16 — CL. 17
BINDING · GOVERNED BY THE LAWS OF [[GOVERNING_JURISDICTION_UC]]
clauses · 16—17
CL. 16
Supplier Indemnity

The Supplier shall indemnify and hold harmless the Customer against third-party claims arising from defective equipment, defective consumables, or the Supplier's negligence, wilful misconduct or breach of this agreement. This indemnity does not extend to loss caused by the Customer's own negligence, misuse of the equipment, or failure to follow the Supplier's operating and cleaning instructions. Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss.

CL. 17
De-installation & Collection

On expiry without renewal, or on termination, the Supplier de-installs and collects the equipment. The Customer provides access within the collection period set out in Cl. 09 or Cl. 12, including any permit to work, loading bay or service lift booking its building requires, and isolates power and water at the service point. De-installation and collection are charged per machine at the rate in Schedule A, invoiced with the final month's consumables. What the visit covers is set out in Schedule C. The fee is waived where the agreement is renewed, where the equipment is replaced under a new term, and where the Customer terminates for the Supplier's material breach. Where collection is prevented for more than ten (10) business days beyond the collection period, equipment rental continues to accrue until the equipment is collected. Risk in the equipment passes to the Supplier when it leaves the Customer's premises.

CL. 18
Change of Site Operator

If during the initial term the Customer ceases, or expects to cease, to be the facilities services provider at the Premises, the Customer shall notify the Supplier and the financing partner in writing no later than sixty (60) days before the change takes effect. The Supplier shall use reasonable endeavours to procure the novation of the Lease from the Customer, in the first instance to the incoming facilities services provider and otherwise to the site occupier, with effect from the date of the change, in accordance with the financing partner's novation process, and shall novate this agreement to the same party on the same terms and date. The Customer shall provide reasonable assistance, including introductions to the incoming party and execution of the financing partner's documents. Novation of the Lease is subject to the financing partner's credit evaluation and approval of the incoming party and to the Customer's account with the financing partner being current at completion, neither of which the Supplier controls; the financing partner's administrative fee for novation is borne by the Supplier. On completion of the novation of the Lease, the Customer is released from this agreement with effect from the same date, save for sums accrued before it.

SCHEDULE C OPERATIONAL ANNEX
CSCHEDULE

Installation,
servicing, and
response.

BINDING · OPERATIONAL DETAIL FOR CL. 02 & CL. 03
C.1 Installation requirements

The Customer shall provide the following utilities at the install location, within one (1) metre of the machine:

  • Power — single phase supply (1P/N/E, 230V, 13A) with circuit breaker
  • Water — fixed supply, minimum 2 bar pressure, ½" thread stop cock (If fixed water input).
  • Drainage — 50 DN, with sufficient gradient (If fixed water input and output).

The Supplier installs the machine free of charge and does not perform carpentry, plumbing, or electrical works.

C.2 Out-of-hours callout

Callouts requested outside the pre-arranged quarterly schedule are charged at the prevailing rates:

Mon–Fri, working hours
[[CURRENCY]] 150.00plus [[CURRENCY]] 50/hr labour thereafter
After hours / weekends / PH
[[CURRENCY]] 200.00plus [[CURRENCY]] 40/hr labour thereafter

Callouts caused by Customer mishandling, failure to clean, or damage attributable to the Customer are charged at the rates above plus parts at cost.

C.3 Response time

The Supplier shall endeavour to rectify reported faults within twenty-four (24) hours of the request. Where a machine is not fixable on-site, the Supplier shall provide a replacement machine of equivalent capacity by the next working day following the failure date.

C.4 De-installation & collection

The fee in Schedule A covers one visit in working hours with ground floor or service lift access: decommissioning, draining and flushing, disconnection and removal of the Supplier's hoses and fittings, and closing the Customer's isolation valve so the service point is left safe.

Capping or altering water and drainage services is plumbing work and remains the Customer's, per Cl. 02, as are carpentry and electrical works, making good, and storage where the site is not ready. A visit aborted for access reasons is charged at the C.2 rates.
